hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|\|)\s*(git commit|npm publish)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"⚠️ Rule reminder: do not commit or publish without explicit user permission."},"continue":true}'; fi
